preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore authored cemetery composition and enemy-spawn fairness, prepare native dense-run qualification, and deliver the required authored choice hierarchy while preserving the native project and cemetery package.

diagnosis.root_cause: The cemetery has a presentation and binding defect: flat blue-green exposure and landmark occlusion persist, while native-map spawn, collision, navigation, and perimeter alignment remain insufficiently proven. Dense profiling reaches its fixture but lacks native frame and physics samples.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and native Godot baseline.
Do not add proxy roads, floor patches, replacement landmark packs, or decorative-family expansion.
Do not claim native performance closure before host recapture and Tester verdict.

strategy.rationale: Separate the three host-selected product surfaces into independent tasks: authored composition, dense profiling, and enemy spawn/motion fairness. Repair environment binding instead of repeating camera transform tuning, and keep the HUD capability bounded within the presentation task.

code: Run Godot import/parse and targeted resource/script checks; verify node paths, resource loads, receipt schemas, exactly-once choice mutation, and release guards.
Exercise dense setup/reset, enemy pool reset, and choice selection hooks in isolated test configuration.
runtime: Host recaptures authored composition from spawn, critical route, cardinal/landmark, ground contact, and perimeter movement states.
Host replays enemy spawn-to-approach-to-death/drop/pool-return at representative density and checks navigation, collision, telegraphs, separation, and stale-state clearing.
Host runs three reset-isolated native 1920x1080 dense profiles and records frame, physics, render, high-water, active-count, and retry-growth evidence.
Host replays choice drafts across keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus and reruns host_godot_boot and native_godot_project preservation checks.
visual: Compare cemetery captures with the bound reference for warm/cool hierarchy, readable shadows, escape lanes, external depth, grounded scale, and stable landmark silhouettes.
Inspect choice cards for authored silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful deltas, restrained copy, distinct focus states, and readable arena composition.
Inspect enemy approach and telegraph frames for readable silhouettes, non-overlap, safe spawn reveals, and absence of static or sliding poses.

done_when: The cemetery is one coherent bounded authored environment with a larger traversable scale appropriate to movement speed, camera footprint, spawn reveal distance, and route variation.
A coherent external world with external depth remains visible beyond the playable perimeter without void leakage or reachable spawn space.
The central building and landmarks remain readable before approach, near contact, and after departure during ordinary movement/movement replay; no disappearance or whole-landmark occlusion occurs.
Visible geometry, collision, navigation, spawn exclusion, and the perimeter boundary agree; the player cannot pass through or become trapped inside prominent landmarks.
Warm lantern/key accents separate from cool moon fill while preserving shadow detail, silhouettes, and escape lanes.

Weapon and upgrade choices lead with authored silhouettes/icons and compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged/exhaustive/NEW/LOCKED current rows, and provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
tasks.instructions: Repair the native cemetery composition and its player-facing presentation binding. Rebase objective and camera framing around native streets, preserve the intact buildings, props, materials, and landmarks, expand the playable datum where cramped, keep the external world non-playable, and use selective roof/facade transparency rather than hiding whole landmarks. Rebalance environment light/material bindings for warm/cool nocturnal hierarchy. In the same bounded presentation pass, implement the authored weapon/upgrade choice hierarchy from authoritative build data with restrained copy, truthful deltas, debounced selection, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus. Provide direct ordinary movement replay and before/near/after landmark retests.
tasks.title: Repair authored cemetery composition and player-facing presentation

done_when: A deterministic dense-profile prepare/advance/reset path reaches 25–40 enemies with required weapon, pickup, animation, VFX, light, UI, and audio systems without changing ordinary wave behavior.
The candidate records nonzero frame, physics, and render samples, bounded distributions/high-water marks, active enemy/projectile counts, renderer/profile label, and reset-isolated cycle identifiers.
Receipts include requested/resolved/setup-generation/reset isolation and a release-build guard; telemetry is not exposed in shipped HUD/export.
Edited scripts and configuration import and boot without runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the candidate dense-profile evidence path and lifecycle hooks. Keep the ordinary director, combat cadence, enemy motion, HUD, and release behavior unchanged. Add bounded timing/counter telemetry and deterministic tester setup, advance, and reset isolation so the host can run three native 1920x1080 cycles. Leave renderer qualification, recapture, and formal verdict to Tester.
tasks.title: Prepare native dense-run performance qualification

done_when: Enemy roles spawn from validated off-camera regions outside the protected camera area and approach along valid navigation without out-of-bounds placement, root sliding, static poses, or first-frame damage.
Enemy separation and steering preserve escape lanes at representative density; dead or pooled actors stop moving, stale state is cleared, and drops resolve exactly once.
